scene_description: Four people — two adults and two children — are sitting around a campfire in a fire pit in the woods. They appear to be roasting marshmallows on sticks. A green tent and camping chairs are visible in the background.

questions.question: What do you see in the middle of the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round metal bowl in the center of the picture.

questions.question: What are the people doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the sticks the people are holding toward the fire.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground around the people.

questions.question: What is the green thing behind the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the people at the big green rounded shape.

questions.question: What might the people eat after they cook their marshmallows?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is on the ends of the sticks over the fire.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been camping or sat around a campfire?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside at night or on a trip.
